themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants, particularly in areas like social benefits and housing. This theme has seen strong convergence in Spain, Italy, France, Hungary, and the UK, with parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, Rassemblement National, and Reform UK leading the charge.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in Andalusian coalition deal with PP, excluding foreign mothers from maternity aid and pushing for stricter immigration controls.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Advocates for policies favoring Italian citizens in welfare and housing, with coalition partners like Lega supporting similar measures.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Proposes strict immigration controls and policies favoring French citizens, including bans on certain cultural expressions like migrant-themed plays.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Tisza government introduces school-start support exclusively for Hungarian families, signaling a shift toward national priority in social policies.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Criticizes local councils for prioritizing asylum seekers over British citizens, demanding stricter immigration policies and national priority in housing.

themes.title: Manuel Adorni scandal paralyzes Argentina's government
themes.blurb: The resignation of Manuel Adorni, Argentina's former Chief of Staff, amid corruption allegations has sent shockwaves through President Javier Milei's administration. The scandal has drawn international attention, with right-wing media in the U.S. and Europe closely following its impact on Argentina's political landscape.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Adorni's resignation and subsequent investigations into alleged illicit enrichment have dominated headlines, leading to a cabinet reshuffle and legislative paralysis.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: U.S. right-wing media highlights the scandal as a potential threat to Trump's support for Milei, questioning the administration's stability.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian media covers the scandal as a cautionary tale about corruption in right-wing governments, with parallels drawn to domestic political challenges.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Spanish far-right media uses the scandal to criticize left-wing governments, framing it as an example of systemic corruption in Latin America.

themes.title: Right-wing parties target LGBTQ+ rights in Europe
themes.blurb: Far-right and right-wing parties in Europe are escalating attacks on LGBTQ+ rights, proposing stricter laws and criticizing Pride events. This theme has seen strong convergence in Spain, Italy, France, and the UK, with parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, Rassemblement National, and Reform UK leading the charge.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Proposes stricter Civic Ordinances banning burqas and squatting, and criticizes Pride events as 'indoctrination' and 'propaganda'.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Criticizes LGBTQ+ rights initiatives, with Lega opposing funding for LGBTQ+ shelters and promoting traditional family values.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Opposes LGBTQ+ cultural events, with local mayors banning migrant-themed plays and criticizing Pride celebrations.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Criticizes local councils for supporting LGBTQ+ events, calling them 'woke' and demanding stricter immigration controls.

themes.title: AfD's constitutional crisis and far-right extremism
themes.blurb: Germany's AfD faces internal divisions and external scrutiny over its extremist ties, with protests and legal challenges threatening its legitimacy. The party's constitutional crisis has drawn attention from right-wing and far-right media across Europe, particularly in France and Italy, where similar movements are closely watched.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: French media closely follows AfD's crisis, drawing parallels to RN's own legal troubles and extremist allegations.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian media covers AfD's extremism allegations, using it to contrast with Meloni's efforts to distance her party from far-right associations.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: UK media highlights AfD's extremism as a cautionary tale for Reform UK, which faces similar scrutiny over far-right ties.

themes.title: Marine Le Pen's legal battles threaten 2027 bid
themes.blurb: Marine Le Pen's eligibility for the 2027 French presidential election hangs in the balance as she faces a critical court ruling on July 7. The case has drawn significant attention from right-wing and far-right media across Europe, particularly in Italy and Germany, where similar legal challenges are being closely watched.

countries.note: Le Pen's appeal ruling could confirm her 5-year ineligibility, potentially barring her from the 2027 presidential race.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian media covers Le Pen's legal battles as a cautionary tale for Meloni, who faces similar challenges in maintaining legitimacy.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: German media draws parallels between Le Pen's legal troubles and AfD's own challenges with extremism allegations.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Spanish far-right media uses Le Pen's case to criticize judicial activism, framing it as an attack on conservative values.
